definitions.road_game: Team is the away team and neutral_site is false. Bowls, kickoff classics, and most conference championship games are neutral. A championship game played on a campus site counts as road (e.g. the 2011 Pac-12 CCG at Autzen Stadium); the neutral_site flag in the game data, not the game type, decides.
definitions.top10_at_kickoff: Opponent ranked 1-10 in the most recent AP poll published before the game date. Preseason poll covers games before the first regular-season poll. AP poll only.
definitions.since: 1990 season onward, postseason included with its season.
definitions.coach_of_record: Head coach on the game date. Interim coaches count as themselves with interim: true. When a titled head coach was absent but retained credit (game-day sideline ban, medical leave), attribution follows the NCAA/school record via data/attribution-overrides.json.
definitions.in_scope_coach: Any FBS head coach with a tenure overlapping a school-season listed in power_conference_eras. All of a scoped coach's FBS HC games count toward the record, including G5 stints.

power_conference_eras.major_independents: Notre Dame 1990-present; Miami, Florida State, Penn State, others count via their independent years before joining a conference

notes: school_assignments is the union of every school that spent time in a power conference 1990-present, grouped for research agents by current or longest affiliation. Tenure coverage per school runs 1990 to present regardless of which conference the school was in for a given season.
